sentences.text: ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE A.J.DESAI) 1

By way of present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, following prayers have been made:
"(A) The Hon'ble Court may kindly be admit and to allow this Special Civil Application.

(B) The Hon'ble Court kindly may be issue a writ of mandamus or any other writ, direction to the Respondent No.1 to considered the objections of the petitioner and amount of the award as per the Section 23(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, in the interest of justice;

(C) Any other and further relief/ reliefs which may be deemet fit just and proper in the interest of justice."

sentences.text: It is the case of the petitioner that the land which was sought to be acquired in the year 2002, the parties have consented for a particular amount of compensation towards the land acquired by the authority.
However, the amount of solatium and interest have not been paid.
3 In response to the notice issued by this Court, the respondents have filed affidavit-in-reply and opposed the grant of relief as prayed for.

4 Ms.S.I.Pathan, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, by taking us through the consent award would admit that solatium and interest is not paid, and therefore, appropriate orders may be passed.
5 On the other hand, Mr.Krutik Parikh, learned AGP, would submit that the award was passed way back in the year 2002 and the petitioner has approached after a period of 21 years.
He would further submit that the consent award imputes the solatium and interest.
He has C/SCA/6496/2022 ORDER DATED: 21/06/2023 taken us through relevant paragraphs of the consent award and submit that the petition be dismissed.
6 We have heard learned advcoates appearing for the respective parties.

Apart from the fact that the petition is filed for consent reliefs after a period of 21 years, however, perusing paragraphs 5 and 10 of the consent award, it appears that the amount decided per hector to the tune of Rs.2,09,950 is agreed upon by the parties which includes solatium and interest was paid immediately to the petitioners.
7 Hence, we do not fine any substance in this petition.
The petition is accordingly, dismissed.
Notice is hereby discharged.
